result.document_summary: A page from the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 2 Article 2 Division 36, covering the City's small and emerging local business (SLBE/ELBE) public works and consultant contracting program, with no residential rental provisions.
result.notes: This part (Division 36, sections 22.3604-22.3617) concerns City procurement from SLBE/ELBE businesses. Although the source URL slug refers to a San Diego rental pricing algorithm section (98.1103), the text actually provided contains no rule on rent setting, rent increases, evictions, deposits, screening fees or screening restrictions, so no in-scope rules were extracted.
